info.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses
info.synopsis: Hayato Kasukabe è stato accettato all'università di Tokyo al suo primo tentativo. Quando riceve la notizia della morte di sua nonna, decide di visitare i luoghi della sua infanzia, tornando al Café Terrace Familia per la prima volta in tre anni e trovandovi cinque strane ragazze che affermano di essere la famiglia della nonna.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Upon learning of his grandma's death, Hayato returns to the café she ran for the first time in years. He plans to shut it down, but finds five girls who formerly worked at Familia living there, and they're determined to save it from demolition...

tmdb.title: Episodio 1

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Hayato decides to reopen his late grandma's café. He begins cohabiting with the five girls who worked there part-time, but naturally, things get off to a rocky start in both the home and the business.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: Hayato decides to reopen his late grandma's café. He begins cohabiting with the five girls who worked there part-time, but naturally, things get off to a rocky start in both the home and the business.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: As Familia is about to reopen, Riho tells Hayato that he needs to get along better with Ouka. He tries hard to make amends with her and repeatedly fails, but her reaction changes when he compliments the waitress uniforms she made...

tmdb.title: Episodio 3

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: A week after Familia's reopening, business is slowing down, so Hayato decides to run a stall at the local Cherry Blossom Festival with new menu items for spring to attract new customers. Everything goes great until some guys try to hit on Ouka...

tmdb.title: Episodio 4

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Riho is working the café floor alone on busy days and planning promotions at night, leading Hayato to wonder if she's working too hard. Later, on the café's day off, Hayato happens to see Akane's band performing while he's buying supplies in town.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: Riho is working the café floor alone on busy days and planning promotions at night, leading Hayato to wonder if she's working too hard. Later, on the café's day off, Hayato happens to see Akane's band performing while he's buying supplies in town.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Shiragiku and Riho compete to see who can make the best toasted sandwich. Ami is acting quieter than usual, and the rest of the gang tries to find out why. As all this goes on, Hayato loses sight of the line between family and working relationships.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Hayato notices that Akane seems down, and suspects she's planning to quit. When he asks her about it, she responds with a defeated look, so he asks her to teach him how his grandma made coffee. His coldness makes Akane wonder what "family" truly is.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Summer has begun, and Hayato decides to open a beach hut to draw more attention to Familia. Its opening day is surprisingly busy, and Riho seems to be working harder than usual to keep up...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Beach hut business is booming, and Hayato feels like the girls are finally communicating more openly with him. But then a TV crew shows up, and the director seems to know Riho, revealing a past she hadn't told any of the Familia gang about.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Ami is being her usual goofy self when Ouka suddenly yells at her. It turns out "Ouka" was actually Ouka's twin sister, Kikka, and she proceeds to insult Familia and all six of its workers. It seems Ouka and Kikka have a complicated relationship...

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The Familia crew visits a bathhouse while their bathtub at home is broken. The wagashi shop owner happens to be there, and she asks the girls how they feel about Hayato, prompting some of them to face their feelings.
